tagline: Colorful emoji stickers for your timeline
summary: Smileys, hearts, hands, animals, food and more, as stickers you can drop onto a video. Also adds the emoji font so every emoji shows correctly in your text.
useCases: Add a reaction to a funny moment
Use emoji inside titles and captions
howTo: Search or browse for an emoji
Drag it onto the timeline or click to add it
Move and resize it in the preview
